info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Realestate Listings Agents-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive database of real estate listings associated with agents. This API allows users to efficiently retrieve detailed information about available properties, including their specifications and agent details. Typical consumers include real estate agencies, property management firms, and individual agents seeking to enhance their listings visibility. With this API, users can streamline their property searches and improve decision-making in the real estate market.

get.summary: Retrieve listings assigned to a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint fetches all the property listings that are associated with a designated agent. It allows users to view the agent's portfolio and understand the properties they are managing.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve listings associated with a specific agent. This body should contain the necessary parameters to filter and obtain the relevant data about the agent's listings.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the listings for the agent.

ListRealestateListingsAgentsRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation on listings for agents. This should contain the necessary parameters to retrieve listings based on certain criteria.
